issues.detail: The Greek 'παντα αποδωσω σοι' (I will give back/render everything to you) is rendered as 'trả hết cho anh' (give back all to him/you). In the context of this verse (Luke 7:48), the servant is speaking to the master. The Vietnamese 'anh' is an informal/peer pronoun, whereas the Greek 'σοι' refers back to the master (the one being addressed). Using 'anh' suggests a peer relationship rather than the master-servant hierarchy established in the first half of the sentence.
